name: Underworld Breach
clause: Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard.

needs.semantics: "Each nonland card in your graveyard has escape. The escape cost is equal to the card's mana cost plus exile three other cards from your graveyard." A permanent that hands an alternative casting cost to cards sitting in another zone. grant-ability reaches only permanents on the battlefield and grants an Ability, never an AltCost; escape exists but only as a declaration on the card that prints it, with a fixed printed mana cost rather than a per-card one.
